description: Tracked baselines index (change protocol step 6, docs/CHANGE_PROTOCOL.md). One entry per recorded baseline (baseline-0, then baseline-N after each default flip). Only hashes are tracked; the run outputs stay local under out/. tools/benchmark/ledger_check.py validates every entry and, when the out directory exists locally, that summary.json still has the recorded sha256 and was written by the recorded runner, manifest and qmg.

entry_schema.qmg_sha256: sha256 of the qmg.exe that produced the run (64 hex)
entry_schema.runner_sha256: sha256 of tools/benchmark/run.py used for the run (64 hex); equals summary.json runner_version
entry_schema.manifest: repo-relative path of the manifest that was run (for example tools/benchmark/rc1-v1.json)
entry_schema.manifest_sha256: sha256 of that manifest file (64 hex); must match tools/benchmark/manifests.json
entry_schema.policy: gate policy of the run: 'v1' or 'draft'
entry_schema.out_dir: repo-relative run directory under out/ (local, git-ignored)
entry_schema.source_snapshot: the summary's identity.source_snapshot (git HEAD, git diff sha256, untracked-list sha256)
entry_schema.cause: the change id whose default flip this baseline records ('none' for baseline-0)
entry_schema.notes: free text, including what the run did not cover (sealed cases, skipped compiles)

baselines.scope: import re-evaluation under the frozen light budget (1020 s): draft cases from their Phase-1 compile, new cases from their baseline-0 compile, q2-tdm-c2 from its 8 x 2 recompile (x1-light-budget run A)
baselines.notes: BENCH-v1 under the v1 gate policy with the Phase-1 build, re-summarized with the light budget frozen at 1020 s (tools/benchmark/decisions.json D11(3)). 410/411 cases, all by --import into one fresh directory with the same runner, binary, policy and budget: the 136 non-sealed draft-v0 cases other than q2-tdm-c2 from out/benchmark-draft (Phase-1 compile), the 273 new cases from out/benchmark-v1/baseline-0/v1-policy (their baseline-0 compile at 8 jobs x 2 threads), and q2-tdm-c2 from out/benchmark-v1/light-budget/top10-8x2 (recompiled at --jobs 8; its Phase-1 light stage had been cut off by the old 600 s cap, the only light time-out in baseline-0). Every import regenerated .map and .qmg.json byte-identical (G8 410/410). Against the superseded summary: G5 409/410 -> 410/410 (q2-tdm-c2 417.249 s <= 1020 s); every other gate count and both all-hard totals unchanged (q2-tdm-c2 still fails G2). 9 of the 10 slowest light times in this summary are Phase-1 timings, which were taken under unrecorded heavier load. Sealed q2-showcase-hero (D26) is not in this run. No --q1-wad (D9 pending), so G12 fails on every Q1 case. source_snapshot is the first result's; the tree is shared with other Phase-2 lanes and moved since the first record (the generator binary is fixed). Per-path G1-G15 table: out/benchmark-v1/baseline-0/v1-policy-frozen-budget-g1-g15.md.

superseded.notes: The first baseline-0 record (change baseline-0), under the provisional 1200 s light budget. G5 409/410: q2-tdm-c2 kept its Phase-1 light time-out at the old 600 s cap. The 137 non-sealed draft-v0 cases were re-evaluated with --import from out/benchmark-draft and the 273 new cases were generated with --repeat 2 and compiled (8 jobs x 2 threads). The directory and its summary are kept unchanged. Per-path G1-G15 table: out/benchmark-v1/baseline-0/v1-policy-g1-g15.md.

baselines.notes: Acceptance 'Baseline-0 reproduces draft' (plan 9.1): the 138 draft-v0 cases imported from out/benchmark-draft under --policy draft. Per-gate counts equal draft-v0 (G1 138, G2 70, G3 138, G4 138, G5 137, G6 40/40, G7 85/29/24, all gates 70); 0 gate and 0 request-status differences; 137 regenerated byte-identical, q2-showcase-hero read only (not regenerated). Cross-checked by an unmodified copy of out/benchmark-draft/probes/bench-verify/verify.py (out/benchmark-v1/baseline-0/verify/): 0 differences. The other 273 BENCH-v1 cases are 'missing' by design.

baselines.label: r1s-q1-intermission
baselines.scope: composite: the 142 in-scope Quake 1 cases compiled with the flipped qmg (out_dir, --repeat 2) plus the 268 out-of-scope cases carried over from baseline-0 by proven byte identity (composite.out_dir)
baselines.notes: Default flip of r1s.q1_intermission (every Quake 1 map gets one info_intermission). The flipped qmg at its defaults regenerated all 459 non-sealed BENCH-v1 and portfolio cases: differences only in the 142 declared in-scope Q1 cases (each map = baseline-0 map + one info_intermission), 0 out of scope; it reproduces the pre-flip switch-on run (maps byte-identical, reports differ only in $.switches and layout_sha256), and --switch r1s.q1_intermission=off reproduces baseline-0's maps. In-scope: compiled here (G1-G7 statuses identical to baseline-0 and to the step-4 switch-on compile; G8 142/142; 142/142 compiled entity lumps hold exactly one info_intermission). Out-of-scope: run.py --import refuses a source produced by another qmg, so these 268 results are carried over from baseline-0 (summary e8cb8e98...) by the byte-identity proof instead of being re-imported; composite totals: all hard gates 228, 211 with G10 reported, every gate count equal to baseline-0. Portfolio baselines (baseline-0-*-portfolio) are unchanged: the flipped qmg regenerates all 49 portfolio cases byte-identically. Sealed q2-showcase-hero (D26) not run. No --q1-wad (D9 pending), so G12 fails on every Q1 case.
